novelty.justification: The core novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: the claim proposes that models may "correctly encode a truth-value but bind it to the wrong item" and that belief failures can be corrected by "re-routing the binding without changing the truth-value representation." The closest work located under searches such as "LLM truth value entity binding," "belief probe binding errors," and "activation patching item attribute binding" is Representational Analysis of Binding in Language Models (EMNLP 2024), which already identifies a low-rank Binding-ID subspace and causally changes entity–attribute assignments, while Truth-value judgment in language models: 'truth directions' are context sensitive (2024) establishes contextual interference in truth probes. Treating truth status as the bound attribute and applying established probing and patching machinery is therefore a natural extension, but linking mis-binding specifically to belief-versus-fact errors and separating item binding from truth encoding changes the unit of analysis enough to constitute a substantive integration rather than a mere renamed instance.
